title: Efficiency-Induced Freezing in Quantum-State Purification
summary: Any nonzero detection loss qualitatively changes feedback-controlled purification under diffusive monitoring. In every finite dimension, we prove a sharp, dimension-independent ceiling on the decay of trajectory-averaged impurity moments, uniformly over admissible predictable feedback protocols.Below unit efficiency, this ceiling becomes independent of moment order above a critical value and is attained on extremal rank-two quantum-nondemolition (QND) faces.
